name: Formula 1: Drive to Survive
description: Drivers, managers and team owners live life in the fast lane — both on and off the track — during each cutthroat season of Formula 1 racing.

videos.title: All to Play For
videos.overview: Driver Daniel Ricciardo looks to make a statement on the track while the teams prepare for the first race of the season at the Australian Grand Prix.

videos.title: The King of Spain
videos.overview: Team McLaren aims to turn things around as its driver Fernando Alonso faces Renault's Carlos Sainz Jr. at the Spanish Grand Prix in Barcelona.

videos.title: Redemption
videos.overview: At the prestigious Monaco Grand Prix, Ricciardo feels pressured by an upstart. Also, the men and women of Williams Racing fight to remain relevant.

videos.title: The Art of War
videos.overview: The troubled offtrack relationship between Red Bull and Renault hits a new low. Meanwhile, a top Formula 1 driver makes a shocking move.

videos.title: Trouble at the Top
videos.overview: A team's financial backing doesn't always translate into victories. See: McLaren. Also, the principal and co-owner of Force India faces legal issues.

videos.title: All or Nothing
videos.overview: When Force India is bought by a group led by Lawrence Stroll, the team's two drivers worry Stroll's son, Lance, may take one of their spots.

videos.title: Keeping Your Head
videos.overview: Perhaps trying too hard, Haas F1 Team driver Romain Grosjean struggles with confidence and nerves at the famed French Grand Prix.

videos.title: The Next Generation
videos.overview: Sauber driver Charles Leclerc hopes to achieve something his late godfather Jules Bianchi never did: race for Ferrari.

videos.title: Stars and Stripes
videos.overview: The bitter rivalry between Renault and Haas heats up, and the mid-tier teams vie for bragging rights at the United States Grand Prix in Austin, Texas.

videos.title: Crossing the Line
videos.overview: Drivers — both legends and upstarts — focus on ending the year on a high note as the teams prepare for the season's final race at Abu Dhabi.

videos.title: Lights Out
videos.overview: Another Formula 1 season kicks off at the Australian Grand Prix as 10 racing teams vie for the podium.

videos.title: Boiling Point
videos.overview: As mediocrity becomes the norm for Team Haas, frustration over the poor performances threaten to tear the group apart from within.

videos.title: Dogfight
videos.overview: Eager to return their teams to glory, Renault's Daniel Ricciardo and McLaren's Carlos Sainz Jr. vow to prove themselves on the track.

videos.title: Dark Days
videos.overview: Lewis Hamilton and the Mercedes team — long dominant in Formula 1 — face a true test of mettle on a rain-soaked track at the German Grand Prix.

videos.title: Great Expectations
videos.overview: Red Bull rivals Max Verstappen and Pierre Gasly race in Monaco, Montreal and Austria, where one driver shines and the other struggles.

videos.title: Raging Bulls
videos.overview: Alex Albon, the newest driver for Team Red Bull, strives to accomplish what his predecessor couldn't. Also, tragedy strikes at the Belgian Grand Prix.

videos.title: Seeing Red
videos.overview: Few — if any — teams have a history that can match Ferrari's. But not even the Prancing Horse is immune to a little interdriver drama.

videos.title: Musical Chairs
videos.overview: For Formula 1 drivers like Nico Hülkenberg, holding on to a job can feel like a game of musical chairs. Will the music stop at the German Grand Prix?

videos.title: Blood, Sweat & Tears
videos.overview: While many believe Williams's best years are long gone, deputy team principal Claire Williams sees a bright future with rookie driver George Russell.

videos.title: Checkered Flag
videos.overview: As the 2019 season winds down, upstart drivers — including Albon, Gasly and Sainz — compete for one last chance at a podium finish.

videos.title: Cash Is King
videos.overview: As the threat of COVID-19 looms at the Australian Grand Prix, one team's new car design causes controversy.

videos.title: Back on Track
videos.overview: The drivers head to Austria for their first race in more than 200 days. Meanwhile, the Red Bull and Mercedes rivalry heats up, on and off the track.

videos.title: Nobody's Fool
videos.overview: Determined to emerge from Lewis Hamilton's shadow, Mercedes driver Valtteri Bottas seizes his chance at the Russian Grand Prix.

videos.title: We Need to Talk About Ferrari
videos.overview: Welcome to the Italian Grand Prix, where Ferrari drivers Charles Leclerc and Sebastian Vettel try to put a much-needed silver lining on their season.

videos.title: The End of the Affair
videos.overview: Renault's Daniel Ricciardo announces a bold move. Multiple teams band together against a rising Racing Point.

videos.title: The Comeback Kid
videos.overview: Following last season's high-profile demotion, Pierre Gasly is eager to show Red Bull team principal Christian Horner that he made a big mistake.

videos.title: Guenther's Choice
videos.overview: Pressured to make changes to his underperforming team, Haas principal Guenther Steiner pursues an up-and-coming driver with massive potential.

videos.title: No Regrets
videos.overview: With driver Carlos Sainz Jr. moving to Ferrari at the end of the season, McLaren puts its faith in his soon-to-be-former teammate, Lando Norris.

videos.title: Man on Fire
videos.overview: Over the course of two drama-filled races, drivers with uncertain futures vie to hold on to their F1 seats. A horrifying crash shocks everyone.

videos.title: Down to the Wire
videos.overview: Racing Point challenges McLaren and Renault at the F1 season finale in Abu Dhabi. Hamilton opens up about being Black in F1.

videos.title: Clash of the Titans
videos.overview: The 2021 Formula 1 season begins at the Bahrain Grand Prix, where drivers give it everything to take the first checkered flag of the year.

videos.title: Ace in the Hole
videos.overview: Now racing for McLaren, Daniel Ricciardo sets out to prove that he's still a force on the track. Meanwhile, teammate Lando Norris puts on the pressure.

videos.title: Tipping Point
videos.overview: Red Bull's Max Verstappen pulls off a string of victories. Lewis Hamilton of Mercedes struggles to keep pace. Later, an accident leads to controversy.

videos.title: A Mountain to Climb
videos.overview: The Haas team looks to reverse its recent fortunes with a new sponsor and two rookie drivers: Nikita Mazepin and Mick Schumacher.

videos.title: Staying Alive
videos.overview: Down but never out, McLaren's Ricciardo goes pedal to the metal in hopes of ruining Ferrari's homecoming at the Italian Grand Prix.

videos.title: A Point to Prove
videos.overview: With Williams Racing under new leadership, the storied team looks to put its recent troubles in the rearview mirror and return to greatness.

videos.title: Growing Pains
videos.overview: They have the raw talent, but can they handle the pressure? Now Yuki Tsunoda and Esteban Ocon must sink or swim in the rough waters of Formula 1.

videos.title: Dances with Wolff
videos.overview: Rumors fly about whether an up-and-coming driver will join Hamilton on team Mercedes, potentially leaving Valtteri Bottas without a seat.

videos.title: Gloves Are Off
videos.overview: Only a few races remain, and for drivers desperate for any advantage they can get their hands on, the gloves are officially off.

videos.title: Hard Racing
videos.overview: As another fierce season comes to a close, Mercedes and Red Bull face off in what may be the biggest winner-takes-all race of a generation.

videos.title: The New Dawn
videos.overview: As the season begins in Bahrain, Ferrari hopes new cars will finally propel them to the top, and Haas makes a risky bet on a last-minute driver switch.

videos.title: Bounce Back
videos.overview: Mercedes principal Toto Wolff works to combat the team's unexpected struggles, while Lewis Hamilton navigates a bumpy ride in the team's redesigned car.

videos.title: Matter of Principal
videos.overview: Ferrari drivers and decision-makers feel the pressure of high expectations at a star-studded new event in Miami and a game-changing race at Silverstone.

videos.title: Like Father, Like Son?
videos.overview: Crashes and costs mount for Haas as driver Mick Schumacher fights to live up to his father's racing legacy and prove his worth to the team.

videos.title: Pardon My French
videos.overview: Otmar Szafnauer's efforts to overhaul Alpine bear fruit — until a new round of driver musical chairs throws his plans for the future into question.

videos.title: Nice Guys Finish Last
videos.overview: Daniel Ricciardo's future starts to look uncertain when McLaren team managers set their sights on new talent, while Alpine weighs the best way forward.

videos.title: Hot Seat
videos.overview: As the Red Bull team pushes to build on their lead against Ferrari, all eyes are on Sergio "Checo" Pérez during a dramatic Monaco Grand Prix.

videos.title: Alpha Male
videos.overview: When Pierre Gasly announces he's leaving Alpha Tauri, Yuki Tsunoda faces losing a teammate and a friend. Can he step up to show that he's ready to lead?

videos.title: Over the Limit
videos.overview: With both championships within reach, Red Bull's team faces incendiary accusations that they've cheated by violating a league-wide spending cap.

videos.title: End of the Road
videos.overview: The 2022 season hurtles toward a conclusion in Abu Dhabi, where Ferrari fights to hold off Mercedes and McLaren hopes for a miracle to overtake Alpine.

videos.title: Money Talks
videos.overview: Lawrence Stroll will do whatever it takes for Aston Martin to become world champion. But his dreams could be over before the new season even starts.

videos.title: Fall from Grace
videos.overview: Hopes are high for Nyck de Vries as he takes his first shot at Formula One. With the pressure mounting, he struggles to keep up the pace.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: McLaren has a lot to prove after last season. As star driver Lando Norris' car lets him down yet again, he starts considering his options.

videos.title: The Last Chapter
videos.overview: It's a battle at the back between Haas and Williams. While one team sticks with tradition, the other's ready to make bold new moves.

videos.title: Civil War
videos.overview: Alpine's Esteban Ocon and Pierre Gasly have been competing since childhood. Can they overcome their rivalry now that they're on the same team?

videos.title: Leap of Faith
videos.overview: Lewis Hamilton's been loyal to Mercedes since he was 13. But winning comes first — and with his contract up for renewal, he has to make a tough decision.

videos.title: C'est la Vie
videos.overview: An investment from Hollywood stars piles pressure on Alpine's management. Between frustrated drivers and disappointing results, something has to give.

videos.title: Forza Ferrari
videos.overview: In Italy, Ferrari is a religion. So when the team arrives in Monza, all eyes are on new principal Fred Vasseur to make fans' prayers come true.

videos.title: Three's a Crowd
videos.overview: Daniel Ricciardo is finally back on the circuit. But when an accident sends him to the sidelines yet again, a rookie reserve steps in to take his seat.

videos.title: Red or Black
videos.overview: With the season nearing its end and the winner already assured, rivals Mercedes and Ferrari are locked in a fierce battle for second place.

videos.title: Business as Usual
videos.overview: Ahead of the new season, the drama has already begun. Lewis Hamilton makes a drastic decision — which is almost overshadowed by a shocking allegation.

videos.title: Frenemies
videos.overview: Lando Norris has spent his career coming second to Max Verstappen. Can this be the year he overtakes his friend and makes a bid for the Championship?

videos.title: Looking Out for Number 1
videos.overview: Without Lewis Hamilton, Mercedes has a seat to fill for 2025. George Russell thinks he's ready to step up to lead driver — but does Toto Wolff agree?

videos.title: Carlos Signs
videos.overview: Dropped from Ferrari, Carlos Sainz has got a big decision to make for next season. As two teams vie for his attention, he gets a call from an old friend.

videos.title: Le Curse of Leclerc
videos.overview: It's the Monaco Grand Prix, and all eyes are on Charles Leclerc. With his country's hopes hanging on his shoulders, the pressure starts to get to him.

videos.title: Wheels of Fortune
videos.overview: The Constructors' Championship is within McLaren's grasp. The car is performing, the drivers are excelling — but their strategy might hold them back.

videos.title: In the Heat of the Night
videos.overview: Five of Formula 1's most famous drivers — and lifelong friends — film their behind-the-scenes experiences of the brutal Singapore Grand Prix.

videos.title: Elbows Out
videos.overview: After a record-breaking 2023, Red Bull has a lot to live up to. With one driver slowing the team down, veterans and newcomers alike battle for his seat.

videos.title: Under New Management
videos.overview: Haas has a new principal. Alpine has welcomed back a legend of the sport. Between them, the rivals are locked in a battle worth millions of dollars.

videos.title: End Game
videos.overview: As the season nears its climax, the outcome hangs on a knife edge. Can underdog McLaren stand a chance against the powerhouses of Ferrari and Red Bull?

videos.title: New Kids on the Track
videos.overview: As a new season begins under the lights of London's O2 Arena, six rookies join the grid and a seven-time World Champion hangs his helmet in a new garage.

videos.title: Strictly Business
videos.overview: Alpine's brutal tactics and Kick Sauber's softer ethos go head-to-head at the back of the grid as rookies struggle to keep their Formula 1 dreams alive.

videos.title: The Number 1 Problem
videos.overview: At a scorching Bahrain opener, McLaren's Oscar Piastri and Lando Norris both chase the title, but only one can win as their fight becomes a mental war.

videos.title: The Bull with No Horns
videos.overview: Red Bull's hunt for pace in Japan exposes car flaws and second-seat tension, while Christian Horner feels the walls closing in.

videos.title: The Sky's the Limit
videos.overview: In Miami, Williams enters a new era as Alex Albon soars and Carlos Sainz struggles to adapt. With tension rising, is the team backing the right driver?

videos.title: The Duel
videos.overview: Mercedes and Ferrari fight for second in the Constructors' title as rookie Kimi Antonelli and legend Lewis Hamilton shoulder expectations in new teams.

videos.title: What Happens in Vegas
videos.overview: Vegas delivers glitz, risk and a new team principal working the pit wall. With the stakes higher than ever, McLaren are willing to take a gamble.

videos.title: Call Me Chucky
videos.overview: After a Vegas setback, McLaren reach Abu Dhabi with their lead under threat from the reigning World Champion. When the flag falls, who holds their nerve?

awards: Nominated for 4 BAFTA 11 wins & 30 nominations total
